increase worldwide as number of priests edges upward the number of catholics worldwide rose by 16.69 million to 1.422 billion last year. catholics accounted for 17.8 percent of a global population of almost 8 billion. for the first time in five years, there is an increase in the total number of priests in the world. the total reached 407,421, up 425 from the previous year. africa was the only continent to register an increase in religious sisters. the number of seminarians fell by 2,891 to 103,604. lay missionaries increased by 18,473 to 463,079. the church also runs 75,448 kindergartens, 103,666 primary schools, and 51,810 secondary schools. healthcare and charitable network include 101,110 facilities, 5,397 hospitals as well as 13,646 dispensaries. pope leo xiv's doctors confirm'no further treatment is necessary' pope leo xiv’s doctors confirm that the tumour removed earlier this month was a lung adenocarcinoma and that the disease was localised, noting that "no further treatment is necessary." we continue to keep the holy father in our prayers. first holy communion classes for children not attending catholic schools the classes begin in november on these dates: sunday 8 november, sunday 15 november, sunday 22 november, and sunday 29 november. the classes will take place in the family room (beside the altar) in the parish church immediately after 11am mass. young adults (18-30) faith group the next gathering will take place on monday 16 november at 7.30pm. parish pastoral council next meeting will take place on wednesday 4 november at 7pm. coeliacs for holy communion we now have the option for coeliacs to receive a low-gluten host for holy communion. these consecrated hosts will be kept in a separate pix for reception from the priest at the altar rails. trim active retirement group social thursday 29 october, castle arch, supper and music 5.30pm music. christmas party sunday 13 december castle arch hotel 1pm.
